visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and a black sleeveless top is seen in a tight close-up, exhibiting an exaggeratedly emotional expression as if crying with joy. High-energy speed lines radiate from her. A Monopoly board lies in front of her on a white table. (2) The scene cuts to the woman sitting on a brown sofa in a brightly lit indoor space. She holds a large white box featuring a historical portrait. She begins unboxing the item, gesturing enthusiastically towards the camera. (3) Detailed macro shots showcase various board game components: colorful property cards, a cast of a hand, and illustrated game cards. The woman's hands are seen pointing at the specific details. (4) An animated/illustrated sequence appears, depicting a young boy in 19th-century attire playing a piano for a lady, followed by an adult man in a tuxedo clapping in a grand hall setting. (5) Back to the woman at the table, she displays small metallic game tokens, including a grand piano, an upright piano, and a top hat. She leans in close to the camera with a wide smile and wide eyes, expressing extreme excitement.
